# Retail CoD United Offensive 1.51b dedicated server, mp_carentan tdm, client-probes/probe_skyshot spot part with the shooter's eye inside the 0x2080 caulk brush (1164..1220, -544..-528, 366..430) over a window, looking flat along +y, bazooka_mp, captured 2026-11-14 inside `unshare -rn`:
#   COD_VERSION=uo COD_DIR=<a UO install> PORT=28997 PROBE_SECS=45 tools/run_probe.sh client-probes/probe_skyshot mp_carentan +set probe_part spot +set probe_weapon bazooka_mp +set probe_x 1192 +set probe_y -536 +set probe_z 340 +set probe_yaw 90 +set probe_pitch 0
